title: The Side Effects of Being Smart: Safety Risks in MLLMs' Multi-Image Reasoning
reasoning: The paper introduces MIR-SafetyBench, a benchmark designed to evaluate MLLMs' multi-image reasoning safety. This benchmark includes categories such as Hate Speech, Harassment, Violence, Self-Harm, Illegal Activities, and Privacy Violations (as detailed in Table 4), which are direct ethical and moral considerations, thus the paper evaluates models on these ethical dimensions.
